headline: Get Paid 13% A Year To Hold UBER Stock You Already Own
summary: Here is a way to get paid a real income now on your Uber shares, cash you keep no matter what, in exchange for agreeing to sell at a higher price if the stock gets there.

headline: Uber’s Robotaxi Ambition to Face Scrutiny as Shares Languish
summary: (Bloomberg) -- The breakdown of Uber Technologies Inc.’s robotaxi partnership with Alphabet Inc.’s Waymo is looming large over the ride-hailing giant’s quarterly results, as investors grow anxious about the stock that has lagged the broader market this year.
